The '''57th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and television for 1999, took place on January 23, 2000.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Wolk|first1=Josh|title="American Beauty," "Sopranos" dominate the Golden Globes|url=http://ew.com/article/2000/01/23/american-beauty-sopranos-dominate-golden-globes/|website=Entertainment Weekly|access-date=10 January 2018|date=23 January 2000}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Lyman|first1=Rick|title='American Beauty' Wins 3 Golden Globe Awards|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2000/01/24/movies/american-beauty-wins-3-golden-globe-awards.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=24 January 2000}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=American Beauty takes 3 Golden Globes|url=http://articles.cnn.com/2000-01-24/entertainment/golden.globes.cnn_1_awards-the-film-dark-drama-golden-globe-awards?_s=PM:SHOWBIZ|access-date=10 January 2018|work=CNN|date=27 January 2000|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121003191749/http://articles.cnn.com/2000-01-24/entertainment/golden.globes.cnn_1_awards-the-film-dark-drama-golden-globe-awards?_s=PM:SHOWBIZ|archive-date=3 October 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=The Golden Globe Winners|url=http://www.sfgate.com/entertainment/article/THE-GOLDEN-GLOBE-WINNERS-2781658.php|access-date=10 January 2018|work=San Francisco Chronicle|date=24 January 2000}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 20, 1999.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Higgins|first1=Bill|last2=Gray|first2=Tim|title=Globes’ ‘Beauty’ pageant|url=https://variety.com/1999/film/news/globes-beauty-pageant-1117760162/|access-date=10 January 2018|work=Variety|date=19 December 1999}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Gumbel|first1=Andrew|title=Mendes film debut `American Beauty' and Kevin Spacey top Golden Globe nominees|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/mendes-film-debut-american-beauty-and-kevin-spacey-top-golden-globe-nominees-1133855.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180111165004/http://www.independent.co.uk/news/mendes-film-debut-american-beauty-and-kevin-spacey-top-golden-globe-nominees-1133855.html |archive-date=2018-01-11 |url-access=limited |url-status=live|access-date=10 January 2018|work=The Independent|date=21 December 1999}}</ref><ref>{{cite Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1999-dec-21-ca-45956-story.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=21 December 1999}}</ref>
